'''Aron Onstall''' was an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Onstall later served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This caused a number of problems for Imperial public relations and led to a major [[Atrivis sector uprising|uprising]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]].<ref name="SOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aron Onstall was first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a supplement released in [[2015]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game.<ref name="SOT" />
